title: Subscription Line Item
description: One recurring line of a subscription: what each recurring order contains for it, and the purchase option it recurs on.

id.description: Identifier of the line, unique within the subscription.

item.description: The item each recurring order contains. `price` is the unit price the next recurring order is placed at, and equals `purchase_option.price`.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item in each recurring order, as a step count of the item's `quantity_unit`.

purchase_option.description: The purchase option the line recurs on, as currently in effect: the same object as the Order line's `purchase_option`, updated for every change since checkout. `title` and `description` name the plan; `price` is the unit price of the next recurring order; `schedules` are the recurring orders still to come, binding. `id` is opaque and need not resolve in the catalog.
